title: My mobile game has 31% bounce rate and 2.2 min avg session — how do I fix early retention?
author: varunkumarnr
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Running a closed beta testing for my first mobile game, it is a roguelike puzzle game, and the numbers are worrying me. 

Current stats:

* 31% bounce rate (leaving within 30 seconds)
* 2m 19s average session
* 19 unique players, 6 returning (31.6% return rate)

The funnel data, signal most players drop off right after the first level. They try one challenge and close.

is this normal or too low for a mobile game?  if any mobile dev would love to hear your side. Thanks.

comments.author: Silkutz
comments.body: too small dataset to get real insights, probs too early to ask this.

replies.author: varunkumarnr
replies.body: Thanks, what should a good average session time look like ?

replies.author: Silkutz
replies.body: For a web game, probs between 2- 10 mins is a good number

replies.author: varunkumarnr
replies.body: Okay this helps very much thanks.

replies.author: varunkumarnr
replies.body: Looks like html build is not stable will need to check,  native game in godot I have not tested the html build I hosted in pixelpicked that caused this issue.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: This post is not specific to AI based game development. See rule #1.
